project_type: Python 3.13 FastAPI + Strands Agents multi-agent backend, React 19 + Vite 8 + Tailwind v4 dashboard, Python CDK infrastructure (deployed stacks HeatWiseData, HeatWiseApi in us-east-1)
build_system: uv-managed venv at heatwise-ai\.venv WITHOUT pip (install with `uv pip install --python .venv\Scripts\python.exe -e ".[dev]"`); npm in heatwise-ai\frontend (save-exact via .npmrc); infra has its own venv at heatwise-ai\infrastructure\.venv. uv writes progress to stderr, which PowerShell shows as red NativeCommandError; check the exit code.
test_framework: pytest 9.2.0 (+pytest-asyncio, respx, moto 5.2.5) with addopts -m 'not live'; Vitest 5 + Testing Library in frontend; aws_cdk.assertions in infrastructure/tests
build_command: frontend: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build` (from heatwise-ai\frontend)
test_command: backend (from heatwise-ai): `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest` (baseline 265 passed, 4 deselected); frontend: `npm test` (baseline 7 files, 46 tests); infra (slow, background): `Start-Process -NoNewWindow -FilePath infrastructure\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -ArgumentList "-m","pytest","infrastructure\tests","-q" -RedirectStandardOutput .data\infra-tests.log -RedirectStandardError .data\infra-tests.err` (baseline 14 passed), then read the log
verification_instructions: 1) Backend pytest all green offline. 2) Frontend typecheck, lint, test, build exit 0. 3) taste-skill lint from frontend: `node "..\..\_reference\taste-skill\skills\taste-skill\scripts\lint.mjs" --app src` 0 FAIL. 4) Infra tests in the background, read the log. 5) Evaluation: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m backend.evaluation run --mode offline`, `... report`; live only once with `--confirm-live`. 6) Optional UI check: offline API `$env:AGENT_MODE="offline"; $env:WEATHER_PROVIDER="demo"; .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn backend.main:app --port 8000` + `npm run preview` (port 5173), inspector `node "..\..\_reference\taste-skill\skills\taste-skill\scripts\inspect.mjs" --app http://localhost:5173/impact`; stop servers afterwards.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/evaluation/results/evaluation-results.json and docs/evaluation.md are generated by `python -m backend.evaluation run|report` and checked in; never hand-edit their numbers. Frontend test fixtures in frontend/src/test/fixtures are generated by `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m backend.tests.export_fixtures frontend\src\test\fixtures` (regenerate only if the report/record shape breaks them). Raw live run reports go to .data/evaluation/ (git-ignored).
environment_constraints: Not a git repo: no worktree, no commits, work in place in d:\github work\SDK workshop\heatwise-ai; coders run strictly in sequence. Do not modify AWS resources or redeploy (deployed: HeatWiseData, HeatWiseApi; API https://pwnenvmo71.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com); read-only AWS calls (sts get-caller-identity, cloudformation describe-stacks) are allowed, preferably through the AWS MCP server. Never call the deployed public API from tests. Automated tests never call Bedrock or the network. Live evaluation is one opt-in run, us-east-1, model us.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0, at most 6 scenarios, well under $1. Infra tests are slow: background + log file. Stop any dev servers you start.
contribution_requirements: Every number in docs must come from a generated results file or a command output produced in this session, with the file cited; no invented statistics, user counts or health-outcome claims (no 'prevented illness', 'reduced mortality', 'helped N people'). External facts (hackathon rules, Builder Center URL, AWS service descriptions, Bedrock price) must be fetched in this session or left as TODO. Pin new dependencies exactly (strands-agents-evals==1.8.0). Keep the needs_human_review verified-only rule (backend coordinator.checklist_for, frontend lib/safety.ts renderablePlanItems) and the phone-number and diagnosis checks (services/claims.py PHONE_NUMBER_RE, tools/verification_tools.py BANNED_PATTERNS) intact. Do not break the 265 backend, 46 frontend, 14 infra tests. Keep spec files (.kiro/specs/heatwise-ai/requirements.md Req 10, design.md, tasks.md 5.1-5.4) in sync. No em dashes in AWS resource names/descriptions.
key_patterns: Numbers come from tool ledgers and deterministic code, models only write text (design D1-D9). Offline agents = real Strands loop with backend/agents/scripted.py ScriptedModel (tool_call/text turns); backend/agents/offline.py build_offline_coordinator builds the five scripted agents. Tests construct Settings(_env_file=None, ...) and conftest strips env vars. API: routes on APIRouter(prefix='/api') in backend/api/routes.py, error envelope {error{code,message,fields}} (404 -> not_found), request models extra='forbid', metrics computed only from stored records (backend/api/summaries.py compute_metrics). Stores: AssessmentStore ABC (save/get/all/list/count/history_for_location), JSON store atomic write under a lock, DynamoDB store with exact item attributes (test_item_attributes). Frontend: useLoad(key, load) hook, api object in src/api/client.ts (GET/POST only), BlockError for in-block errors, cards `rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-5`, tokens in src/index.css (text-title, text-section, text-kpi, text-body, text-small, warn-*), one heat hue only on data, risk/status as Pill pairs with text labels, mockApi/renderApp/fixtures/recordFor in src/test/helpers.tsx, each route sets its title via AppShell routeTitle. CDK: explicit iam.PolicyStatement per resource, no wildcard actions, no Resource '*'.
directory_structure: heatwise-ai/backend: agents/ (coordinator + 4 specialists, hooks, scripted model, offline builder), tools/, services/ (risk_rules, claims, validation, weather/{base,open_meteo,demo,factory}), guidance/ (catalog 43 items, TRUSTED_SOURCES), models/, session/ (stores, sessions, DynamoDB schema), api/ (FastAPI), evaluation/ (empty package; M5 adds datasets/, results/, dataset.py, provider.py, metrics.py, adversarial.py, runner.py, results.py, live.py, judge.py, report.py, __main__.py), tests/, cli.py, config.py, lambda_*.py. heatwise-ai/frontend/src: api/, components/, lib/, routes/ (Landing, AssessForm, JobProgress, History, report/{Climate,Risk,Plan,Activity}View, ReportLayout), test/. heatwise-ai/infrastructure: app.py, stacks/, scripts/, tests/, cdk.out and build (git-ignored). heatwise-ai/docs: architecture.md, deployment.md (M5 adds evaluation.md, agent-workflow.md, builder-center-article.md, demo-script.md, submission-checklist.md). Spec lives outside the repo in ../.kiro/specs/heatwise-ai/.
